Drop your photos in this folder, then reference them in src/photos.js as
"/photos/<filename>".

For the "See the difference" before/after section, save your side-by-side
image here as exactly:

    before-after.jpg

It will appear automatically. (If you use a .png, name it before-after.png
and update the path in src/photos.js to match.)

Other photos you can add and reference in src/photos.js:
  - hero image
  - one image per service card (post / commercial / residential)
  - the work-gallery grid

Until a file exists, that spot shows a soft gold gradient instead of breaking.
